about: USB-C 3D glasses known to Sparky Stereo OS, by the EDID identity they announce. One file, two readers: Stereo KWin carries the identities (src/outputconfigurationstore.cpp, s_stereoGlasses) and the Windows glasses keeper embeds the file. Every entry comes from a real EDID read from those glasses and published, or read from an owner's glasses; the EDID files are in Stereo KWin's autotests/integration/data, their sources in usb-c-glasses-edids.txt. Checked by sparky-os/tests/check-stereo-glasses-table.py.
mode_rule: The first detailed timing of the EDID at twice the panel width means Full SBS; at the panel width it means 2D or Half SBS, which the cable cannot tell apart. The glasses' own Real 3D mode is 2D to the computer. Stereo KWin takes the side by side (full) twin only when the glasses announce a mode two eyes wide under a known identity, so glasses whose Full SBS EDID is not published are known by their 2D identity and the twin follows if they keep it in Full SBS, as the XREAL One Pro, the XREAL Air 2 Pro and the VITURE Pro XR do. A state no public record shows is listed under not_public, never guessed.
